verses.original: תִּמְשֹׁ֣ךְ לִוְיָתָ֣ן בְּחַכָּ֑ה לְשֹׁנֽוֹ׃ תַּשְׁקִ֥יעַ וּ֝בְחֶ֗בֶל
verses.transliteration: tim·šōḵ liw·yā·ṯān bə·ḥak·kāh lə·šō·nōw taš·qî·a‘ ū·ḇə·ḥe·ḇel
verses.literal: Can you pull in Leviathan with a hook or tie down his tongue . . . with a rope

verses.original: הֲתָשִׂ֣ים אַגְמ֣וֹן בְּאַפּ֑וֹ תִּקּ֥וֹב לֶֽחֱיוֹ׃ וּ֝בְח֗וֹחַ
verses.transliteration: hă·ṯā·śîm ’aḡ·mō·wn bə·’ap·pōw tiq·qō·wḇ le·ḥĕ·yōw ū·ḇə·ḥō·w·aḥ
verses.literal: Can you put a cord through his nose or pierce his jaw with a hook

verses.original: הֲיַרְבֶּ֣ה אֵ֭לֶיךָ תַּחֲנוּנִ֑ים אִם־ יְדַבֵּ֖ר אֵלֶ֣יךָ רַכּֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yar·beh ’ê·le·ḵā ta·ḥă·nū·nîm ’im- yə·ḏab·bêr ’ê·le·ḵā rak·kō·wṯ
verses.literal: Will he beg you for mercy or speak to you softly

verses.original: הֲיִכְרֹ֣ת בְּרִ֣ית עִמָּ֑ךְ תִּ֝קָּחֶ֗נּוּ לְעֶ֣בֶד עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hă·yiḵ·rōṯ bə·rîṯ ‘im·māḵ tiq·qā·ḥen·nū lə·‘e·ḇeḏ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: Will he make a covenant with you to take him as a slave for life

verses.original: הַֽתְשַׂחֶק־ בּ֭וֹ כַּצִּפּ֑וֹר וְ֝תִקְשְׁרֶ֗נּוּ לְנַעֲרוֹתֶֽיךָ׃
verses.transliteration: haṯ·śa·ḥeq- bōw kaṣ·ṣip·pō·wr wə·ṯiq·šə·ren·nū lə·na·‘ă·rō·w·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: Can you pet him like a bird or put him on a leash for your maidens

verses.original: חַבָּרִ֑ים יִכְר֣וּ עָ֭לָיו יֶ֝חֱצ֗וּהוּ בֵּ֣ין כְּֽנַעֲנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ḥab·bā·rîm yiḵ·rū ‘ā·lāw ye·ḥĕ·ṣū·hū bên kə·na·‘ă·nîm
verses.literal: Will traders barter for him or divide him among the merchants

verses.original: הַֽתְמַלֵּ֣א עוֹר֑וֹ בְשֻׂכּ֣וֹת רֹאשֽׁוֹ׃ דָּגִ֣ים וּבְצִלְצַ֖ל
verses.transliteration: haṯ·mal·lê ‘ō·w·rōw ḇə·śuk·kō·wṯ rō·šōw dā·ḡîm ū·ḇə·ṣil·ṣal
verses.literal: Can you fill his hide with harpoons or his head with fishing spears

verses.original: שִׂים־ כַּפֶּ֑ךָ עָלָ֥יו זְכֹ֥ר מִ֝לְחָמָ֗ה אַל־ תּוֹסַֽף׃
verses.transliteration: śîm- kap·pe·ḵā ‘ā·lāw zə·ḵōr mil·ḥā·māh ’al- tō·w·sap̄
verses.literal: If you lay a hand on him you will remember the battle and never repeat it

verses.original: הֵן־ תֹּחַלְתּ֥וֹ נִכְזָ֑בָה הֲגַ֖ם אֶל־ מַרְאָ֣יו יֻטָֽל׃
verses.transliteration: hên- tō·ḥal·tōw niḵ·zā·ḇāh hă·ḡam ’el- mar·’āw yu·ṭāl
verses.literal: Surely hope of [overcoming] him is false Is not the sight of him overwhelming

verses.original: לֹֽא־ אַ֭כְזָר כִּ֣י יְעוּרֶ֑נּוּ וּמִ֥י ה֝֗וּא יִתְיַצָּֽב׃ לְפָנַ֥י
verses.transliteration: lō- ’aḵ·zār kî yə·‘ū·ren·nū ū·mî hū yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣāḇ lə·p̄ā·nay
verses.literal: No one is so fierce as to rouse Leviathan Then who . . . is able to stand against Me

verses.original: מִ֣י הִ֭קְדִּימַנִי וַאֲשַׁלֵּ֑ם כָּל־ תַּ֖חַת הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם הֽוּא׃ לִי־
verses.transliteration: mî hiq·dî·ma·nî wa·’ă·šal·lêm kāl- ta·ḥaṯ haš·šā·ma·yim hū lî-
verses.literal: Who has given to Me that I should repay him Everything under heaven is Mine

verses.original: לֹא אַחֲרִ֥ישׁ בַּדָּ֑יו וּדְבַר־ גְּ֝בוּר֗וֹת וְחִ֣ין עֶרְכּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: lō ’a·ḥă·rîš bad·dāw ū·ḏə·ḇar- gə·ḇū·rō·wṯ wə·ḥîn ‘er·kōw
verses.literal: I cannot keep silent about his limbs . . . his power and graceful form

verses.original: מִֽי־ גִ֭לָּה פְּנֵ֣י לְבוּשׁ֑וֹ מִ֣י יָבֽוֹא׃ בְּכֶ֥פֶל רִ֝סְנ֗וֹ
verses.transliteration: mî- ḡil·lāh pə·nê lə·ḇū·šōw mî yā·ḇō·w bə·ḵe·p̄el ris·nōw
verses.literal: Who can strip off his outer coat Who can approach [him] with a bridle

verses.original: מִ֣י פִתֵּ֑חַ דַּלְתֵ֣י פָ֭נָיו סְבִיב֖וֹת אֵימָֽה׃ שִׁנָּ֣יו
verses.transliteration: mî p̄it·tê·aḥ dal·ṯê p̄ā·nāw sə·ḇî·ḇō·wṯ ’ê·māh šin·nāw
verses.literal: Who can open his jaws . . . ringed by his fearsome teeth

verses.original: אֲפִיקֵ֣י מָֽגִנִּ֑ים גַּ֭אֲוָה סָ֝ג֗וּר חוֹתָ֥ם צָֽר׃
verses.transliteration: ’ă·p̄î·qê mā·ḡin·nîm ga·’ă·wāh sā·ḡūr ḥō·w·ṯām ṣār
verses.literal: [His] rows of scales are [his] pride tightly sealed together . . .

verses.original: אֶחָ֣ד יִגַּ֑שׁוּ בְּאֶחָ֣ד לֹא־ וְ֝ר֗וּחַ יָב֥וֹא בֵֽינֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ’e·ḥāḏ yig·ga·šū bə·’e·ḥāḏ lō- wə·rū·aḥ yā·ḇō·w ḇê·nê·hem
verses.literal: One scale is so near to another that no air can pass between them

verses.original: יְדֻבָּ֑קוּ אִישׁ־ בְּאָחִ֥יהוּ יִ֝תְלַכְּד֗וּ וְלֹ֣א יִתְפָּרָֽדוּ׃
verses.transliteration: yə·ḏub·bā·qū ’îš- bə·’ā·ḥî·hū yiṯ·lak·kə·ḏū wə·lō yiṯ·pā·rā·ḏū
verses.literal: They are joined to one another they clasp and cannot be separated

verses.original: עֲ‍ֽ֭טִישֹׁתָיו תָּ֣הֶל א֑וֹר וְ֝עֵינָ֗יו כְּעַפְעַפֵּי־ שָֽׁחַר׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ăṭî·šō·ṯāw tā·hel ’ō·wr wə·‘ê·nāw kə·‘ap̄·‘ap·pê- šā·ḥar
verses.literal: His snorting flashes with light and his eyes are like the rays of dawn

verses.original: לַפִּידִ֣ים יַהֲלֹ֑כוּ מִ֭פִּיו אֵ֝֗שׁ כִּיד֥וֹדֵי יִתְמַלָּֽטוּ׃
verses.transliteration: lap·pî·ḏîm ya·hă·lō·ḵū mip·pîw ’êš kî·ḏō·w·ḏê yiṯ·mal·lā·ṭū
verses.literal: Firebrands stream from his mouth fiery sparks shoot forth

verses.original: עָשָׁ֑ן יֵצֵ֣א מִ֭נְּחִירָיו נָפ֣וּחַ כְּד֖וּד וְאַגְמֹֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ā·šān yê·ṣê min·nə·ḥî·rāw nā·p̄ū·aḥ kə·ḏūḏ wə·’aḡ·mōn
verses.literal: Smoke billows from his nostrils as from a boiling pot over burning reeds

verses.original: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ גֶּחָלִ֣ים תְּלַהֵ֑ט וְ֝לַ֗הַב יֵצֵֽא׃ מִפִּ֥יו
verses.transliteration: nap̄·šōw ge·ḥā·lîm tə·la·hêṭ wə·la·haḇ yê·ṣê mip·pîw
verses.literal: His breath sets coals ablaze and flames pour from his mouth

verses.original: עֹ֑ז יָלִ֣ין בְּֽ֭צַוָּארוֹ דְּאָבָֽה׃ תָּד֥וּץ וּ֝לְפָנָ֗יו
verses.transliteration: ‘ōz yā·lîn bə·ṣaw·wā·rōw də·’ā·ḇāh tā·ḏūṣ ū·lə·p̄ā·nāw
verses.literal: Strength resides in his neck and dismay leaps before him

verses.original: מַפְּלֵ֣י בְשָׂר֣וֹ דָבֵ֑קוּ יָצ֥וּק עָ֝לָ֗יו בַּל־ יִמּֽוֹט׃
verses.transliteration: map·pə·lê ḇə·śā·rōw ḏā·ḇê·qū yā·ṣūq ‘ā·lāw bal- yim·mō·wṭ
verses.literal: The folds of his flesh are tightly joined they are firm - and immovable . . .

verses.original: לִ֭בּוֹ יָצ֣וּק כְּמוֹ־ אָ֑בֶן וְ֝יָצ֗וּק תַּחְתִּֽית׃ כְּפֶ֣לַח
verses.transliteration: lib·bōw yā·ṣūq kə·mōw- ’ā·ḇen wə·yā·ṣūq taḥ·tîṯ kə·p̄e·laḥ
verses.literal: His chest is as hard as a rock as hard as a lower millstone

verses.original: מִ֭שֵּׂתוֹ אֵלִ֑ים יָג֣וּרוּ יִתְחַטָּֽאוּ׃ מִ֝שְּׁבָרִ֗ים
verses.transliteration: miś·śê·ṯōw ’ê·lîm yā·ḡū·rū yiṯ·ḥaṭ·ṭā·’ū miš·šə·ḇā·rîm
verses.literal: When Leviathan rises up the mighty are terrified they withdraw before his thrashing

verses.original: חֶ֭רֶב מַשִּׂיגֵ֣הוּ בְּלִ֣י תָק֑וּם חֲנִ֖ית מַסָּ֣ע וְשִׁרְיָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ḥe·reḇ maś·śî·ḡê·hū bə·lî ṯā·qūm ḥă·nîṯ mas·sā‘ wə·šir·yāh
verses.literal: The sword that reaches him has no effect nor does the spear or dart or arrow

verses.original: יַחְשֹׁ֣ב בַּרְזֶ֑ל לְתֶ֣בֶן נְחוּשָֽׁה׃ רִקָּב֣וֹן לְעֵ֖ץ
verses.transliteration: yaḥ·šōḇ bar·zel lə·ṯe·ḇen nə·ḥū·šāh riq·qā·ḇō·wn lə·‘êṣ
verses.literal: He regards iron as straw and bronze as rotten wood

verses.original: לֹֽא־ קָ֑שֶׁת יַבְרִיחֶ֥נּוּ בֶן־ אַבְנֵי־ קָֽלַע׃ נֶהְפְּכוּ־ לְ֝קַ֗שׁ ל֥וֹ
verses.transliteration: lō- qā·šeṯ yaḇ·rî·ḥen·nū ḇen- ’aḇ·nê- qā·la‘ neh·pə·ḵū- lə·qaš lōw
verses.literal: No arrow can make him flee . . . slingstones . . . become like chaff to him

verses.original: תוֹתָ֑ח נֶחְשְׁב֣וּ כְּ֭קַשׁ וְ֝יִשְׂחַ֗ק לְרַ֣עַשׁ כִּידֽוֹן׃
verses.transliteration: ṯō·w·ṯāḥ neḥ·šə·ḇū kə·qaš wə·yiś·ḥaq lə·ra·‘aš kî·ḏō·wn
verses.literal: A club is regarded as straw and he laughs at the sound of the lance

verses.original: תַּ֭חְתָּיו חַדּ֣וּדֵי חָ֑רֶשׂ יִרְפַּ֖ד טִֽיט׃ חָר֣וּץ עֲלֵי־
verses.transliteration: taḥ·tāw ḥad·dū·ḏê ḥā·reś yir·paḏ ṭîṭ ḥā·rūṣ ‘ă·lê-
verses.literal: His undersides are jagged potsherds spreading out the mud like a threshing sledge . . .

verses.original: מְצוּלָ֑ה יַרְתִּ֣יחַ כַּסִּ֣יר יָשִׂ֥ים יָ֝֗ם כַּמֶּרְקָחָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: mə·ṣū·lāh yar·tî·aḥ kas·sîr yā·śîm yām kam·mer·qā·ḥāh
verses.literal: He makes the depths seethe like a cauldron he makes the sea like a jar of ointment

verses.original: יָאִ֣יר נָתִ֑יב אַ֭חֲרָיו יַחְשֹׁ֖ב תְּה֣וֹם לְשֵׂיבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: yā·’îr nā·ṯîḇ ’a·ḥă·rāw yaḥ·šōḇ tə·hō·wm lə·śê·ḇāh
verses.literal: He leaves a glistening wake behind him one would think the deep had white hair

verses.original: אֵֽין־ עַל־ עָפָ֥ר מָשְׁל֑וֹ הֶ֝עָשׂ֗וּ לִבְלִי־ חָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: ’ên- ‘al- ‘ā·p̄ār mā·šə·lōw he·‘ā·śū liḇ·lî- ḥāṯ
verses.literal: Nothing on earth is his equal a creature devoid of fear

verses.original: יִרְאֶ֑ה כָּל־ גָּבֹ֥הַּ ה֝֗וּא מֶ֣לֶךְ עַל־ אֵֽת־ כָּל־ בְּנֵי־ שָֽׁחַץ׃ס
verses.transliteration: yir·’eh kāl- gā·ḇō·ah hū me·leḵ ‘al- ’êṯ- kāl- bə·nê- šā·ḥaṣ
verses.literal: He looks down on all the haughty he is king over - all the proud
